gaps.title: Missing offline synchronization
gaps.jtbd: When using the system without a reliable connection, I want to access materials offline and sync them later, so that continuous learning is supported.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given a client application, When the user goes offline, Then previously synced materials are available. Given an offline action, When connectivity is restored, Then the state syncs with the server.
gaps.reason: Literal brief requirement: 'Возможность добавления материалов в офлайн-режиме с последующей синхронизацией'.

gaps.title: Missing Russian language localization
gaps.jtbd: When navigating the interface, I want to see UI elements in Russian, so that I can understand and use the system efficiently according to the project requirements.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given the web interface, When a user accesses it, Then UI labels and buttons are in Russian.
gaps.reason: Literal brief requirement: 'Интерфейс на русском языке'. Currently, App.svelte uses English strings (e.g., 'Search Results', 'Suggested Documents').

gaps.title: Missing retirement date for archived versions
gaps.jtbd: When a document is updated, I want the previous version preserved with an explicit retirement date, so that audit and compliance requirements are met.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given a document update, When the new version is created, Then the older version is marked as archived with the date of decommissioning.
gaps.reason: Literal brief requirement: 'При замене документа автоматически сохранять предыдущую версию в архиве с указанием даты вывода из эксплуатации'.

gaps.title: Missing concurrent editing locks
gaps.jtbd: When multiple users edit a document simultaneously, I want the system to handle conflicts, so that changes are not silently overwritten.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given two users editing the same document, When one saves, Then the other is notified of a conflict upon saving.
gaps.reason: Literal brief requirement: 'Поддержка многопользовательской работы без конфликтов редактирования'.

gaps.title: Missing pagination on search endpoint
gaps.jtbd: When searching documents, I want the results to be paginated, so that large sets of data do not overwhelm the server or client.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given a search query returning many results, When the API is called, Then the response is paginated (e.g., using page and size).
gaps.reason: Domain-standard expectation: A public list endpoint for searching a potentially large knowledge base needs pagination. The current implementation accepts pagination parameters but ignores them, returning a flat list.
